4.47.betting_forecast: 3/1 Lightkeeper, Rocky's Howya, 4/1 Jerandme, 5/1 You Done Well, 12/1 God Of Thunder, Woodstream Lad, 14/1 Solly Attwell,
4.47.spotlight_verdict: The suggestion is LIGHTKEEPER who is rated 128 over fences and was runner-up in this grade at Bellewstown last year when last over hurdles. A spin in the charity race at Punchestown can have him straight. Jerandme goes well fresh and is reliable so can run well. Rocky's Howya is well-treated by conditions if rebounding from a poor run last time. [Tyrone Molloy]

horses.spotlight_comment: Maiden over hurdles is rated only 85 so can't be fancied in this company.
horses.breeding: b g Elusive Pimpernel - Racing Dream

horses.spotlight_comment: Won for the second time over hurdles when taking a Down Royal handicap last year; not bad efforts over hurdles and on the Flat lately but needs a fair bit more.

Limerick maiden hurdle winner last year but hasn't been as good in this sphere since and refused to race at Bellewstown; not a bad Flat run at Roscommon three days ago but questions back in this discipline.

Not heavily raced for his age with eight wins between all disciplines; was runner-up in a C&D claimer when last seen over hurdles and had one solid AW Flat run since; can go well fresh and is one to consider.

Maiden hurdle winner in 2024 has won three chases since and is rated 128 in that sphere; was second in a Bellewstown claimer in August when last over hurdles; a spin in the charity race at Punchestown can have him straight; valuable 5lb claimer a help.
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Our Victoria

horses.spotlight_comment: Is 1-16 over hurdles and rated only 87 so has loads to find in this company.

Nine-time point winner won three in a row earlier this year on heavy, claiming hurdles at Limerick and Naas plus a handicap chase at the former track; blowing hard after pulled-up in a Wexford novice last time; might find this trip sharp; blinkers.
horses.trainer: Mrs Margaret C Kiely D Queally
horses.breeding: b g Ask - It's My Choice

horses.spotlight_comment: Won twice over fences last September and not a bad chase run at Perth last time; poor on last hurdles run behind Rocky's Howya in March; others preferred.
horses.trainer: Del Boy Partnership C M Collins

horses.spotlight_comment: Hurdle and dual chase winner was poor in this sphere last time after a couple of falls chasing; isn't well-treated at these weights.
horses.trainer: Barrow Vale Syndicate Ms M Mullins

horses.spotlight_comment: Course hurdle winner was last successful in a Downpatrick handicap in 2025; was pulled-up on recent return at Punchestown and has to bounce back.
horses.breeding: b g Soldier Of Fortune - Alfa Belle

horses.spotlight_comment: Second runner for yard; a record of 1-12 over hurdles; was a 12l runner-up in a Tramore claiming hurdle last time so can run well but needs to do more.
horses.breeding: ch g Decorated Knight - Secret Quest

5.20.betting_forecast: 1/3 Springhill Warrior, 5/1 Tomthescaffolder, 6/1 Minella Diamond, 14/1 Loyal Touch, 16/1 Tolka Row, Welcome Back, 22/1 Ajp
5.20.spotlight_verdict: Rated 118 after finishing runner-up on all three hurdle starts in testing ground, SPRINGHILL WARRIOR should take this once handling the faster surface. Minella Diamond is a bumper winner but will find it tough to give 8lb to the selection. Tomthescaffolder showed ability on his first bumper run last year and can run well on hurdling debut. [Tyrone Molloy]

horses.spotlight_comment: Maiden on the Flat but has shown some ability; unseated early on hurdling debut for this yard and poor on the level since; others preferred.
Some promise on bumper debut but was below that level at Punchestown last time; best watched on hurdling debut.
Not much sign of promise in a point and maiden hurdle so makes no appeal on yard debut.
Maiden on the Flat after 18 goes and rated 51; of limited appeal on hurdling debut.
Beaten 44l on hurdling debut at Tramore and can only be watched for now.

Third foal; dam unraced half-sister to 1m2f Group 1 winner Bay Bridge; sire a brother to Frankel and can get decent jumpers; only made Eur1,600 as a foal so seems best watched unless the market speaks.
Was keen and ran green on debut in a bumper last summer; best watched on return.
Five-time Flat winner is rated 70 in that sphere; beaten 21l on hurdling debut at Down Royal recently; can do better.
Pulled-up on sole point run (sft) in February; has a fair pedigree and can do better but a watching brief seems best.

Bumper winner in 2023 ran his best race over hurdles when second at Fairyhouse in November having returned after an absence; some decent runs since but was poor back at the same track last time and has to return to best.
Showed some ability in bumpers last year but was tailed-off on return/hurdles debut at Wexford; can only be watched.

Runner-up in all three starts in 2m maiden hurdles at Navan, Punchestown and Fairyhouse, the latter two earlier this year; those runs were all on testing ground but should be difficult to beat if as effective on this terrain; tongue-tie and cheekpieces added; trip should be fine.
Has been poor in two heavy-ground maiden hurdles; may do better on this ground but one to watch.
Ran to a similar level in defeat in three points during the spring; could run respectably on hurdling debut.
Showed promise on debut in a Listowel bumper last autumn but was poor at Wexford next time; in good hands and can do better on this return now hurdling.
A fine third on debut in a Navan maiden hurdle in 2024; interrupted career since but did win a point in 2025 before lesser hurdle runs; needs to return to his best on stable debut after a year away.
Hasn't shown a lot of promise in three bumper starts and isn't easy to fancy.

5.50.betting_forecast: 11/2 Itaintmebabe, 13/2 Global Skies, 7/1 The Sugarhill Lady, 15/2 Kilbarry Ce Ce, 8/1 Andyourbirdcansing, Whiskey Serenade,
5.50.spotlight_verdict: Very open, a tentative selection going to SARAH'S EXPRESS following an encouraging comeback run. Dangers include Itaintmebabe, Whiskey Serenade, Global Skies and The Sugarhill Lady, while the veteran Hob's Angel could go well at a price. [Alan Hewison]

horses.spotlight_comment: Front-runner's sole win came in 2m2f Sligo mares' maiden in 2024 (good), good second in Limerick handicap over a year ago off 99; 0-10 chasing and well held back hurdling when last seen in October; ground to suit, don't rule out off this reduced mark.
horses.trainer: We Win Racing Syndicate J Ryan

horses.spotlight_comment: Third reserve; lightly-raced mare yet to show anything, never sighted on last moth's handicap debut at Tramore.

First reserve; two heavy-ground hurdle wins include over C&D two years ago; regressed last season although was in the process of running a seasonal-best when faller two out at Limerick last month when still in contention; quicker ground here a concern.
horses.trainer: Mrs W M Fitzpatrick L Archdeacon

horses.spotlight_comment: Some promise in maidens but well held in three handicaps in second half of last year; best watched on return.
horses.breeding: b g Idaho - Gift Of The Gods

horses.spotlight_comment: Wins have been divided between Tramore and Wexford, all on decent ground; long losing run however and continues to struggle off plummeting mark.
horses.breeding: b m Walk In The Park - Taleia

horses.spotlight_comment: Never figured in three maidens and dropped right away from three out on handicap debut at Limerick a year ago; best watched after such an absence.
horses.breeding: b g Highland Reel - Romane Grandchamp

horses.spotlight_comment: Longstanding maiden was placed on a couple of occasions this time last year; entitled to come on from last month's comeback run so don't rule out with rider's claim a positive.
horses.trainer: Ms Yvonne Hennessy & H Williams J Barcoe

horses.spotlight_comment: Won easily on handicap debut at Fakenham (2m4f, good to soft) in October but well held twice following month when trained by Sara Humphreys; first run for Gordon Elliott and no surprise if he eked out some improvement.
Maiden's best runs have tended to be at Tramore, including last month's fourth in 2m1f handicap off this mark, on returning from winter break; prominent racer should run her race but vulnerable.
horses.trainer: Mrs Con O'Keeffe & Tadhg O'Sullivan & Anthony C O'Keeffe
horses.breeding: b m Pillar Coral - Kilbarry Demon

horses.spotlight_comment: Hasn't troubled the judge in maidens or in three handicaps; handicapper relenting and still has time on his side and interesting jockey booking.
horses.breeding: b g Victory Song - Little Memories

horses.spotlight_comment: Promise as a 3yo hurdler but mixing hurdles and fences of late to no avail; now 17lb below her opening mark.
Largely struggled in handicaps until much more encouraging effort off reduced mark at Cork last month, staying on fourth over 2m (yielding); return to longer trip could see her in the mix here.
horses.trainer: Eamon Leahy & Seamus O'Riordan & Carmel E McNamara

horses.spotlight_comment: Runner-up in a point-to-point, nothing so far in maiden hurdles; potential improver now entering handicaps, market worth a look.

Point-to-point winner and placed in modest maiden hurdle at Tramore (2m5f, good) last summer; couple of spins over fences didn't work out, returning last month with okay run in Cork handicap hurdle; tongue-tie now tried and don't rule out.

6.20.betting_forecast: 11/2 Ballingurteen, 6/1 Tedworth, 15/2 Soldier Saint, 8/1 Loi Des Jeux, Old Kenmare, 10/1 Finnicky Filly, Koeur A Prendre, 12/1
6.20.spotlight_verdict: As wide open as the first division. Recent Limerick second Ballingurteen rates a major player, as does Tramore winner Tedworth. However, a chance is taken on LOIS DES JEUX improving on this better ground. Others to consider include Old Kenmare and Soldier Saint. [Alan Hewison]

horses.spotlight_comment: First effort of note over hurdles came when second in 2m4f Limerick handicap last month, having raced up with the pace on soft-to-heavy; up just 1lb so could go well if handling these quicker conditions.
Hurdles win came at Tramore back in 2022, more recently won over fences at Wexford last summer; soft ground not ideal of late so improvement on the cards back on a sound surface.
horses.trainer: Mrs Patrick J Flynn P J Flynn

horses.spotlight_comment: Won here over 2m1f in December (heavy) off 78 and little of note until staying-on second over 2m3f at Kilbeggan last month (good-to-yielding); down to a competitive mark and one to consider.
Second reserve; nothing in previous years and well held on last month's comeback (yard debut) after forcing it at Bellewstown; hard to fancy.
First reserve; placed twice back in 2024, last month's comeback run here wasn't devoid of promise; tongue-tie now tried and longer trip no problem.
Off the mark with narrow Thurles handicap win off 92 in November (2m, yielding to soft); has struggled since off revised mark, and needs to bounce back.
Never counted in three maidens last season; market may prove best guide on handicap debut but riding arrangements encouraging.
horses.trainer: Koeur A Prendre Partnership M Molloy

horses.spotlight_comment: Three hurdle wins at around 2m on soft/heavy; on a long losing run however, returning from long absence in November and well held ove fences; back down to his lowest winning mark and new headgear combination tried.
Maiden form hardly progressive and of limited appeal now entering handicaps.
Third reserve; pulled up on both comeback runs last month at 2m; upped in trip here.

Placed twice here this time last year on similar ground and returned here twice last month, latest when making much of running in finishing fourth of 16 over 2m1f; keen sort now tried in cheekpieces and will need to settle better to see out this longer trip.
Pulled up on opening two handicap runs over further; drops in trip.
Returned from six months' absence to get off the mark at Tramore last month, coming off pace under today's rider (2m5f, yielding); up 6lb so more needed but respected.

6.50.betting_forecast: 4/1 Ned In The Park, 9/2 Oh So Charming, 5/1 Le Diablo, 6/1 Le Kap, 8/1 Arctic Flame, Penny Express, 10/1 Colleen Danu,
6.50.spotlight_verdict: Last-time-out winners Ned In The Park and Le Diablo are obvious ones for the shortlist. However, it could pay to take a chance on OH SO CHARMING, a C&D winner who has been dropped in the ratings after a couple of poor runs in claiming races. [Alan Sweetman]

horses.spotlight_comment: Useful form in the first half of last season on decent ground, won a Down Royal maiden after several solid placed efforts; very soft ground was against her on reappearance at Limerick last month; may begin to prosper again on better going.
horses.breeding: b m Walk In The Park - Arctic Lady

horses.spotlight_comment: Has shown his best form over longer distances and may need this after 13 months off; most recent of his four wins was over an extended 3m1f at Catterick early last year on soft ground.
horses.breeding: b g Poet's Voice - Ship's Biscuit

horses.spotlight_comment: Three-time hurdles winner in 2023, showing a liking for a test of stamina in testing conditions; now 3kb below his last winning mark; Bbest run for Sam Curling last season was over fences; may find the ground too lively; first outing for this stable.
Mild promise in four starts for Pat Doyle; 33-1 when pulled up on handicap debut last October; a revelation here last month, making all to a 33-1 win; 9lb higher, may have turned a corner.

Best maiden run when third at Punchestown last June; little impact on handicap debut at Navan, better at Gowran in August; returned from a break to make all over C&D on yiedling ground a month ago; can remain competitive off 5lb higher
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Shyaway

horses.spotlight_comment: Sole win over hurdles came in a C&D handicap last June off 111; has slumped in the ratings; potentially interesting despite having failed to feature in claiming races in his two 2026 starts; runs off 99, with a good claimer taking off 5lb into the bargain.
horses.breeding: b g Charm Spirit - Scattered Petals

horses.spotlight_comment: Runner-up in back-to-back maiden hurdles laat June at 2m/2m3f; fair effort when fourth on handicap debut at Tipperary; soft ground given as an excuse when pulled up at Killarney; showed a tendency to hang when third in a Tramore maiden inAugust; absent since
horses.breeding: b g Irish Wells - Lady Germany

horses.spotlight_comment: Placed in a point, generally poor form over hurdles; pulled up on chase debut at Fairyhouse on latest in January; cheekpieces tried now.
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Jolucy

7.20.betting_forecast: 2/1 Nirisque, 7/2 Crossbar Getaway, 15/2 Game Phoenix, 8/1 Heatherhill Lady, Jumbos Jet, 9/1 Our Girl Ellie, 10/1 Carleys Lilly,
7.20.spotlight_verdict: Providing she handles these quicker conditions then NIRISQUE can go one better than at Tramore recently. In an ordinary maiden, place claims are held by the likes of Our Girl Ellie, Crossbar Getaway and Jumbos Jet, while the most interesting debutantes look to be Carleys Lilly and Heatherhill Lady. [Alan Hewison]

horses.spotlight_comment: Beaten 25l in bumpers at Listowel and Cork last summer; can only be watched on hurdles debut.
Modest Flat maiden and well held on both maiden hurdle runs last season.

Cheaply bought Blue Bresil mare is half-sister to bumper/2m7f hurdle winner Chance The Robin; unraced dam closely related to high-class bumper and 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Snoopy Loopy; market best guide on debut.

Bumper win here came on heavy, now 0-14 hurdling, pick of recent form when second on similar ground in Gowran mares maiden in March, didn't get beyond the first at Tramore last time (Nirisque second); ground could be plenty quick for her.

Couple of decent runs in bumpers last summer, two maiden hurdle runs not so good, soft ground may not have suited second occasion; seasonal return and ground more in her favour in what looks a modest maiden.
Placed in a couple of good-ground maiden hurdles last summer, absent since well held on chase debut in October.
horses.trainer: Mrs B Power & John J Phelan P Power
horses.breeding: ch m Phoenix Of Spain - Alsrab

horses.spotlight_comment: Zambezi Sun half-sister to 1m4f Flat and useful 2m-2m4f hurdler Ted Hastings; dam modest maiden half-sister to 2m7f/3m hurdle winner Shoofly Milly; debutante from respected source so any market strength has to be noted.
Ordinary form in bumpers and two hurdle runs haven't offered a huge amount; may be more one for handicaps.
Daughter of Renaissance Man is first foal of a modest maiden; not much to go with on breeding, best watched.

Vadamos half-sister to winners The Greek (useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase), Templebredin (2m4f chase), Create The Future (point) and Davitt Road (point); dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m4f-3m5f hurdle/chase winner Newbay Prop; debutante worth a market check.

Vadamos half-sister to winners The Greek (useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase), Templebredin (2m4f chase), Create The Future (point) and Davitt Road (point); dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m4f-3m5f hurdle/chase winner Newbay Prop; debutante worth a market check.
Has shown fair level of ability in bumpers and probably need the comeback run at recent Punchestown festival; out of a half-sister to Faugheen, could be interesting now switched to hurdles.

Half-sister to several French jumps winners; dam French 1m7f-2m2f hurdle/chase winner (inc Grade 3 hurdle); runner-up in a 2m2f hurdle race in France before joining Henry de Bromhead, better of two maiden hurdle runs on latest when clear second in 2m Tramore mares maiden last month under positive ride (soft); quicker conditions here, should go well if handling them.
horses.trainer: Hannahbelle Racing Limited H De Bromhead
horses.breeding: ch m No Risk At All - Nikoline

horses.spotlight_comment: Fair form in six attempts in maiden hurdles, pick being close third in Killarney mares maiden last October (yielding); didn't appear to stay 2m4f on handicap debut later that month; definite player if forward enough on reurn to action.
horses.breeding: b m Doyen - Our Girl Lucy

horses.spotlight_comment: Struggled in a bumper in 2024 and nothing so far in three attempts hurdling.
Two-time Gowran Flat winner (good/yielding); reappeared from winter break at same venue in March when tailed off on hurdles debut on heavy; ground more in her favour here but still best watched.
Well held in both bumpers last season, likely best watched on hurdles debut.
Showed nothing in three maidens last season.

7.50.betting_forecast: 2/1 Chanceawetmorning, 7/2 Sense Of Occasion, 5/1 Theflyingbee, 7/1 Expound, 10/1 Tingarran Express, Tir Og, 12/1
7.50.spotlight_verdict: With Josh Williamson taking off 5lb CHANCEOFAWETMORNING (nap) can add to the win gained when a strong favourite at Kilbeggan on stable debut. A likely danger is Theflyingbee who ran a fine race when third in a big-field handicap at the Punchestown festival. Others to consider are last year's winner Expound and dual course winner Tingarran Express. [Alan Sweetman]

horses.spotlight_comment: Has recorded her only two wins over hurdles at this venue, both over longer distances than this; stuck to her task over 2m4f here last October; failed to exploit a much lower chase mark here the following month and absent since.
horses.trainer: Cora Greene & Vera Deegan A Mullins

horses.spotlight_comment: Best effort for Noel Kelly when second of 12 finishers (beaten favourite) over 2m4f at Fairyhouse in January; flopped when favourite at Ayr in March; justified good support when winning easily at Kilbeggan on first appearance for Gordon Elliott; raised by 9lb, but Josh Williamson's 5lb claim could help him to follow up.
horses.breeding: b g Snow Sky - Jim's Article

horses.spotlight_comment: Made almost all to win this race last year (Ballycashin third); ran well off 10lb higher mark at Tramore in August; otherwise has done all his racing on the Flat over the past year; placed on multiple occasions, fair form late; fourth of nine at Ballinrobe last Friday.

Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner last summer after four consecutive placed efforts; out of her depth subsequently in much stronger company; faller on chase debut at Tramore in January; again set an ambitious task as outsider of three in a conditions hurdle at Limerick in March, this is more realistic.
horses.breeding: b m Lauro - Good Times Had

horses.spotlight_comment: Point winner; won a 2m1f Wexford maiden hurdle last August; was then poor at Navan on handicap debut; much better but still well beaten at Punchestown on second attempt; finished sixth at Kilbeggan last month, rider weighed in light, disqualified.

Runner-up in a point-to-point on good-to-yielding; showed a fair standard of form in maiden hurdles on winter ground; clear of the remainder when second in a six-runner contest at Limerick last month; different ground now, good chance if he handles it well.
horses.trainer: John P McManus H De Bromhead
horses.breeding: b g Soldier Of Fortune - Loughaderra Flame

horses.spotlight_comment: Career highlights when winning back-to-back handicap hurdles at Gowran and Punchestown in November 2024; a long way below his best in a light 2025 campaign that included two poor runs over fences; well held by Theflyingbee on Punchestown running.
horses.breeding: ch g Hillstar - Wouldnt Doubt Ya

horses.spotlight_comment: Useful mare; went a bit high in the ratings after winning at Downpatrick last June; now back on a mark only one pound higher and holds a big chance in this company on the strength of her third placing in a 24-runner contest at the Punchestown festival.
horses.trainer: Mrs F Hand F G Hand

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual course winner, also placed here four times; battled well from the front to land a mares' handicap at Tramore last August (good); probably in need of the run on course return in February; likely to strip fitter now; won here on her second start after a break last year; strong contender.

Progressed really well in the early part of last season, rising 30lb in ratings, stemming from three wins and two seconds; probably too high in the ratings now; was unsuited by the race conditions at Killarney last Friday, so should not be judged harshly on that account.

8.20.betting_forecast: 5/4 Lirakali, 7/2 It's All Clear, 5/1 Martymill, 10/1 Away To Paris, Black Bog Lad, 14/1 Mindyourheadmike, Mistakenforanother,
8.20.spotlight_verdict: Not much substance to the form here, and it will be no surprise if Henry de Bromhead's LIRAKALI proves equal to the task on his debut. Its All Clear could pose a threat if sustaining the improvement shown at Kilbeggan. Martymill, who shaped with promise first time out at Fairyhouse, fared much less well on her second outing. [Alan Sweetman]

horses.spotlight_comment: An E11,000 3yo; second foal; dam, by Robin Des Champs, unraced half-sister to useful winners Not Many Left, Coverholder and Angus Milan;
First foal; Mahler gelding; dam was of little account on the track, decent pedigree, out of a winning half-sister to leading French jumper Cyrlight.
Three-figure odds at Thurles and Cork and has run accordingly, tailed off both times; tongue-tie fitted now.

Finished with only one behind him in a 12-runner Leopardstown bumper won by the subsequent Cheltenham winner The Mourne Rambler; backed at high prices in the morning, sent off 12-1; had obviously shown something and may do much better on good ground.

Placed on point debut for respected producer Ellen Doyle in February 2024; pulled up at Portrush later that year; reported to have burst blood vessels when 14-1 for a bumper at Wexford last August; his new trainer fits him with a hood

Stepped up on the form of soft-ground events at Naas and this venue when fourth at Kilbeggan; 50-1 then, likely to be one of the leading fancies now in what looks a weaker contest; better ground was probably the key to his improvement, and the form could be solid with Gavin Cromwell and Willie Mullins responsible for the placed horses

E40,000 3yo; eighth foal; brother to a Polish jumps winner, half-brother to a French chase winner Miralka; dam French hurdle winner; top stable had three winners over jumps at Killarney on Saturday/Monday; likely a prime contender in an ordinary bumper.
Surpassed market expectations when fourth of 14 at 150-1 on debut at Fairyhouse last November; failed to match that effort at the same venue in January.
Made mistakes when pulled up on sole points start; never showed with a chance at Bellewstown last month; in good hands but hard to fancy.
Fifth foal; Free Eagle mare is a sister to a Slovakian winner, half-sister to Mywayistheonlyway, a four-time winner at up 7f; dam US 6f-1m winner.

Placed on point debut for respected producer Ellen Doyle in February 2024; pulled up at Portrush later that year; reported to have burst blood vessels when 14-1 for a bumper at Wexford last August; his new trainer fits him with a hood
